Commentary.Commentary: End of a long tour and the Englishmen have come out with flying colors! Results that will please the hosts completely. They were at it on every occasion and didn't let the intensity drop. They inflicted a clean sweep on South Africa and followed it with another one against the Windies. The only disappointment would be losing the semi-final of the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy against Pakistan as they were tipped as the favourites. The all-important Ashes is coming up in November and the confidence will be high heading into the series. On the other hand, the Windies showed glimpses of individual brilliance but failed to come through as a team. They will head back home and need to polish their skills. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. Goodbye and cheers!
Time for celebration! Eoin Morgan has been handed over the trophy. He poses along with his teammates for photographs. Happy English faces all around!

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says that he is extremely proud of his side. Mentions that they have continued their form from the Champions Trophy. States that they have been convincing against a strong side like West Indies. Feels that they have played as a team, going out and getting big scores is a great thing. Praises Bairstow for the way he plays. Adds that he has made his limited opportunities count. Reckons that they need to improve their fielding. Feels that it is not a worry but they are far away from being the best fielding side in the world. Adds that winning by 9 wickets was great. Mentions that Curran's performance against South Africa was good and he is happy that he delivered here. Opines that they cannot rely on the spinners every time and adds that the pace bowlers need to make the ball move sideways. Declares that the preparation for the 2019 World Cup is good. Feels that they are confident heading into the Ashes. Ends by saying that it has been a satisfying summer.

West Indies skipper, Jason Mohammed says that they didn't deliver under pressure. Mentions that the bowlers are wicket-takers especially Jerome Taylor but it didn't work in this series. Credits the English batters for playing well. Adds that they could have been much better in the field. States that they need to rotate strike more frequently when they bat. Opines that with some of the senior guys back, they will inspire the youngsters.

MOEEN ALI IS THE MAN OF THE SERIES. He says that he has played the way he likes and it has paid off. Mentions that the short boundaries help. Adds that it is not easy to bat at No. 8 but is pleased with his big-hitting. States that Adil Rashid takes a lot of wickets and he enjoys bowling along side him. States that he can't wait for the Ashes in Australia.

JONNY BAIRSTOW HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. He says that he is very pleased to end the summer with some runs. Mentions that the first hundred was more important. Adds that he capitalized on that and continued his form. States that when you get an opportunity, you need to take it. Expresses that he is happy with his performance. Reckons that both Hales and Roy outscore him and feels that this is the reason they have scored heavily in the last 18 months. Ends by saying that he will take rest for the two next weeks and go back to the gym.

Special mention needs to be given to Jonny Bairstow and Jason Roy. The former grabbed the opportunity to bat at the top of the order with both hands, scoring two centuries in the series. Roy had lost his place due to a lean patch but has come back with a bang. With these two performing, it puts more pressure on Alex Hales. There will be competition for places in the playing eleven now. Perhaps, a good headache to have for Eoin Morgan.  Stay tuned for the presentation...

The visitors tried everything but with minimal success. The hero of the last game, Alzarri Joseph struggled and was taken to the cleaners. In fact, every bowler was tonked all around the park, leaving them hapless in the process. The tourists looked clueless and surrendered without a fight. Two consecutive century stands sealed the deal for the hosts. A fitting way to end the long English summer!

An apt term to describe this chase will be flawless. With that, England inflict a 4-0 clean sweep on the Windies. 289 looked like a competitive target but the home side has made a mockery of it. Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow came out with intent, scoring at will. Nothing seemed to trouble them and they kept on motoring along. Roy missed out on a century by a mere 4 runs but Bairstow hit a fabulous unbeaten ton to take his side over the finishing line along with his Yorkshire teammate, Joe Root.

SIX! Thumping way to win the game! Clean as a whistle! This has been a complete domination from the Englishmen. Fullish delivery outside off, Root leans ahead and lifts it down the ground for a maximum. ENGLAND WIN BY 9 WICKETS WITH 72 BALLS TO SPARE. The English camp is delighted! Customary handshakes all around.
Fullish delivery, knocked to long on for a run.
Similar length outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter in length on middle, punched through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Sublime! Floated outside off, Bairstow extends his arms and strokes it through extra cover for a boundary. England just a hit away from a win.
Played with the spin to mid-wicket.
Marlon Samuels is back on.
On the boots, helped around the corner for a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.

FOUR! Bairstow has looked flawless today! Tossed up outside off, Bairstow creams it through extra cover to pick up another boundary. This is the highest individual score for an Englishman against the West Indies in ODIs.
On the pads, nudged through backward square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Slapped! Fullish on off, Bairstow smashes it past mid off for a boundary.
Fullish on off, Root reverse sweeps it to short third man for a run.
Ashley Nurse is back on.
Short again, pulled to fine leg for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. One run added to the total.
Short delivery outside off, left alone. Wide signaled for height.
FOUR! Crunched! Length delivery outside off, Bairstow punches it on the up through covers for a blistering boundary.
Straying on the hips, helped to fine leg for a brace.

FOUR! Fullish and shaping in. Bairstow whips it through mid-wicket. Ambris in the deep runs to his left, looks very clumsy and ends up making a mess of it with a slide. Looks like while he tried to keep the ball back in play, his leg came in contact with the ropes. The replays confirm so. That must have hurt.
Wide! Cummins slips this one down the leg side. Jonny looks to clip it away but misses. The 100-run stand comes up between the two. It has brought them to the brink of victory.
Short of a length outside off, slapped to point.
Good length delivery, shaping into Root. Worked to mid on.
Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off, Jonny plays it with an angled blade behind point for a run.
Shaping into Jonny. Punched off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, driven on the up to covers.

FOUR! As easy as you get! Short delivery on middle and leg, sits up nicely for Bairstow. He pulls it with aplomb through backward square leg. Powell in the deep races to his right, looks to show his fancy football skills but fails to stop it. He needs to be careful, can easily get injured.
On a length outside off, tapped to point for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball through point. One run added to the total.
Short of a length on off, Jonny makes room and slaps it with a vertical bat to mid off. A single taken.
Full toss on off, Bairstow fails to capitalize on it. Mistimes his push to mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Nicely done! Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Bairstow pulls it all along the ground through backward square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a couple.
Short again, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. One run added to the total.
Angling into Joe. Flicked to deep mid-wicket for a couple.

2nd ODI century for Bairstow in ODIs! Both his tons have come in this series and that too as an opener. Good length delivery outside off, Jonny taps it to third man for a single. This knock speaks volumes about his capability with the bat. He pumps his fists in the air and has a big smile on his face. The entire English dressing room is up on its face. It has been a colorful display of strokes from the wicket-keeper batsman all around the field.

FOUR! Pure timing! Back of a length delivery outside off, Bairstow punches it elegantly through covers. The fielder from the region sprints after it, slides but only parries the ball over the ropes along with him. Bairstow moves on to 99 with that.
FOUR! Hit with disdain! In the slot outside off, Biatstow stands his ground and swipes it through mid on for a rocketing boundary.
Time for Drinks. Meanwhile, the substitute, Brathwaite is on the field. The visitors are taking ages to get going again.
Length delivery outside off, Root shuffles across, walks down the track and looks to play it across but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short of a length around off, shaping in. Root is cramped up a bit as he chops it to point.
Full delivery on off, Bairstow times it elegantly to mid on and crosses through for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Bairstow shuffles across and clips it to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, eased down to mid on for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Miguel Cummins comes back into the attack.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to Gayle at short cover. The big man leaps and throws it towards the keeper with his left hand. He is an animated character.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! Shortish delivery well outside off, Bairstow waits for it and upper cuts it over point. The ball plugs in the field but has enough on it to roll to the fence.
Short of a length delivery around off, Root taps it besides the pitch and sneaks in a run.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed towards backward point. This time Root wants the run but Jonny sends him back.
Good length delivery in the zone of apprehension. Bairstow guides it to third man for a run. Eggs his partner for the second but this time Root is not keen on taking the challenge.

FOUR! Bairstow is easy on the eye! All about timing and elegance! Back of a length delivery outside off, Bairstow uses the pace and places it uppishly behind point. Nicely done and the ball whistles away to the boundary.
Jerome Taylor returns for a bowl. The search for wickets continues.
On a length on off, Jonny milks it down to long on for a run.
Fullish delivery around off, Jonny shuffles a touch and defends it.

Brilliant running! How quick is Bairstow between the wickets! Good length ball outside off, Jonny guides it behind point. Straightaway calls for the second. Pushes his Test skipper to run hard and completes it with ease.
Length delivery outside off, Root cuts it behind point for a run.
FOUR! Errs in line and pays the price for it! You can't be bowling there with fine leg inside the circle. Too full and straight, Root tickles it past short fine leg to find the fence.
Fullish on middle, driven to mid on for a brisk single.
Good length delivery outside off, Root taps it towards backward point. Wants a run but is sent back.
Fuller in length outside off, Root strokes it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Fullish in length, clipped with the angle to mid-wicket.
Joseph searches for the yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on off. Root does well to dig it out to wide mid on.

FOUR! Put away with ease! Short delivery on middle and leg, Root pulls it in a controlled manner through backward square leg. There is a bit of dew on the outfield and as a result, the ball skids through. Beats Powell in the deep and the ball races to the fence.
Length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery around off, comes on quicker than Root expects. He ends up toe-ending his pull to deep mid-wicket for a run and he will retain the strike.
Overpitched this time, driven past the bowler for a run.
Straight on this occasion. Turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off. Jonny runs it down to third man for a run.
Shaping in on a length to the wicket-keeper batsman. He knocks it towards mid on where the fielder dives to his right to make a good stop.
Length delivery on off, Jonny dabs it to covers.
Back of a length outside off, Jonny places it to Powell at backward point who dives to his left but fumbles a bit. The batsmen sneak in a run.
Pinpoint yorker on off, Joe is alert to it and digs it out towards short third man. A single taken. The Windies need more of such deliveries to surprise the batsmen.
Back of a length delivery, glided to third man to rotate strike.
Short delivery on middle, Root pulls it all along the ground through backward square leg for a single.
A tad fuller in length, Root puts his head down and defends it calmly.
On a length on middle and leg, Root tucks it around the corner for a couple. The running between the wickets is once again fantastic.
Fuller in length, driven down to long on for a single.
Length delivery, shaping in from around off. Bairstow aims to cut it but ends up chopping it behind point. A run taken.
Angling into the hips, Jonny nudges it through backward square leg for a brace.
Slower delivery outside off, Bairstow mistimes his punch to covers.
Angling down the leg side, Root helps it through square leg for a run. Runs are coming easily for the Englishmen.
Back of a length outside off, placed through cover-point for a single.
Rovman Powell is introduced into the attack.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, eased to short cover.
Full length ball on off, wristed to mid on.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Shaping into Jonny. He clips it off the inner half to mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Fullish ball, stroked to mid off.
Short of a length on middle, tucked through square leg for a run.
Two Leg byes! Slanting down the leg side, Bairstow looks to clip it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls to fine leg. Two leg byes taken.

What happened there? Joseph is ready to begin his over but is told to wait. The third umpire informs Michael Gough that Cummins has bowled a ball less and he needs to complete it. The fast bowler has to come all the way from fine leg. Poor lad!
Angling into Root, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on.

A loud appeal for an LBW turned down! Fullish delivery on off, angling in. Root looks to play it across but misses to be pinged on the pads. Cummins is confident but the umpire stays put. However, Mohammed does not go for the review. The Snicko shows that there wasn't any inside edge but it may have gone down the leg side. Tight call!
On a length outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.

Five Wides! Bonus runs for England! The visitors can't afford that. Short delivery outside off, Bairstow shapes for the pull but doesn't go for it. The ball lands in front of Shai Hope and spins past him to go through to the fence. Sloppy stuff!
Shortish outside off, Jonny cuts it over point. Taylor dives to his right and makes a brilliant stop. Two runs taken.
On the pads, clipped to the leg side for a run.
Flighted delivery, milked to long on for a single.
Spinning into Jonny. Nudged through square leg for a single.
Stays back to this one and tucks it to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Short outside off, Root cuts it past point. Cummins chases after it but slips. However, manages to keep the ball in play. Saves a run for his side.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total. A wicket and 8 runs from the over.
Short delivery outside off, cut through point to rotate strike.
Wide! Down the leg side, Jonny misses out on his tuck.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Short delivery, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Joe Root strides out to bat.

OUT! Roy departs after playing a swashbuckling knock! A really sad way to get dismissed, he only missed out on a century by 4 runs. Fuller length delivery on off, angling in. Roy aims to knock it through mid on to rotate strike but misses to get rapped on the pads. It looks dead. As soon as the appeals go up, the umpire raises his finger. Bairstow asks Jason whether he got an inside edge on that but the elegant opener says that he didn't and keeps walking back to the pavilion. The Ageas Bowl crowd rises up on its feel to acknowledge his knock. The 156-run opening stand comes to an end. Can the visitors trigger a collapse?
Short delivery on middle, Roy pulls it towards deep backward square leg. Powell in the deep runs to his right and slips a bit but manages to cut it off. Two runs taken.
Miguel Cummins comes back for a burst. Time is running out for the visitors. They need wickets desperately.
Outside off, dabbed to third man.
Spinning in from a shorter length outside off, Bairstow mistimes his cut to covers. Failed to capitalize on that.
Tossed up delivery, eased with the spin to mid on for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.

FOUR! Hit hard and he moves into the 90s with that! Shortish on middle, Roy flat-bats it past the bowler for a rocketing boundary. The Windies do not have any clue at the moment. Perhaps, time to go back to the quick bowlers.
Flatter one, punched to long on for a run.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Floated outside off, Roy skips down the track and whacks it over cow corner for a maximum. 15 from the over.
Dabbed to short third man for a run this time.
FOUR! Shot! Fullish delivery, Bairstow sweeps it hard through backward square leg. The fielder near the ropes dives but fails to stop it.
Outside off, Roy guides it past the keeper. Taylor sprints after it from short third man and saves a run for his side.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.
Tossed up outside off, Jonny eases it to mid off.
On the boots, flicked through square leg for a run. Five singles from that over.
Floated delivery, defended off the front foot.
Roy uses his feet again. He is not quite to the pitch of it but manages to drive it to mid on for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish delivery, eased to long on to rotate strike.
Flatter on off, Bairstow punches it down to long on for a run. That brings up Bairstow's 6th ODI fifty. He has made his opportunity count at the top of the order. Well played!
Fullish delivery, flicked past mid-wicket for a run.
Drifting into Jonny. He knows where the gaps are. Places it through in front of square leg for a couple.
Shortish around off, hit to mid off.
Floated around off, Jonny clips it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Flighted delivery, Bairstow lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up delivery, Bairstow uses his feet and chips it uppishly over wide mid on. Two runs taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Short delivery outside off, Roy looks to force it through covers but gets it off the outer half past short third man. Cummins from the same region hares after it, puts in a slide to keep the ball in play. The umpires check upstairs for it. The replays show that the ball was in his hands while his leg touched the ropes.
Quicker one on off, milked to long on for a single.
Floated around off, Roy drives it with the spin down to long on for a run.
Spinning into Jonny. He works it through square leg to rotate strike.
Flat delivery on off, milked down to long on for a run.

Time for Drinks. England are cruising along at the moment. Roy and Bairstow have kept the scoreboard ticking, punishing the loose deliveries as well. England need 178 more to win from 204 balls. The Windies need regular wickets to transfer the pressure on the hosts. Meanwhile, Bairstow has a change of bat.
Camps back to the shortish delivery and punches it to long off for a run.
Fullish on middle and leg, Roy clips it through backward square leg for a couple. These two have run really well between the wickets.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Flatter one, Roy flat-bats it and it goes on to hit the stumps at the bowler's end.
Taylor is at deep point now.
Continues to be short. Punched off the back to sweeper cover for a brace.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a run.
Marlon Samuels to roll his arm over. He will be bowling after a long time.
Fraction short this time, Roy punches it to long on. The fielder is a bit lazy and the batsmen cash in on the opportunity. Couple taken. Good judgement from these two.
Short delivery on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, spinning in. Roy goes for the cut is but cramped for room. Ends up getting it to covers for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated delivery, knocked down to long on for a run. 100 up for England and it is met with a huge cheer from the crowd.
Roy uses his feet to the tossed up delivery and plays it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, tucked to mid-wicket for a run.
Taylor goes to Joseph and has a chat with him. Perhaps, words of encouragement for the talented young bowler.
FOUR! The shoulders are drooping for the Windies. These two are motoring along well. Short ball in line of the stumps, Roy swivels across and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fractionally overpitched on off, Bairstow checks his drive to mid on for a brisk single.
Similar delivery outside off, cut to backward point.
Back of a length well outside off, Jason cuts it to deep point for a single.

FOUR! The margin for error is less for this flamboyant batsman. Short delivery on middle, sits up nicely for Roy. He pulls it with aplomb past the short mid-wicket fielder and the ball races to the fence.
The sun is shining in all its glory in Southampton now.
Places this with the spin to short mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery, skidding through. Roy punches it to long on to rotate strike.
Jonny skips down the track and milks this one to long on for a run.
Turn on that occasion! Outside off, spinning in sharply. Bairstow shapes for the cut but ends up chopping it towards the keeper.

Fullish delivery, knocked to long on for a run. That brings up Roy's 11th ODI fifty. Back-to-back half centuries for him. He lost his place in the side but has made the opportunities count. The crowd loves it.
Fraction short outside off, skids through and also stays a bit low. Roy still goes for the cut but gets beaten.
Short delivery on middle and leg, Bairstow pulls it uppishly over backward square leg. Powell sprints to his right and keeps it down to a couple.
Full length delivery just outside off, Roy works it to wide mid on for a run.
Angling into Jonny. Nudged to deep square leg to rotate strike.
Short of a length delivery, kept out off the back foot.

FOUR! Well played! Short and width on offer, Bairstow rises up on his toes and cuts it over the point region to pick up a boundary. Didn't try to overhit it, knew where the gap was and placed it deliberately.
Length delivery on leg stump, tucked straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Alzarri Joseph comes back for his second spell.
Fullish on middle, Jonny milks it down to long on for a run and he will retain strike.
FOUR! Elegant! Floated outside off, Bairstow leans into it and strokes it through extra cover for a majestic boundary.
Spinning into Jonny. He clips it to mid-wicket.
Shortish on off, Bairstow goes for the punch but mistimes it to Nurse.
Fullish delivery on off, knocked to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, eased to covers.

Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Four fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Meanwhile, spin is introduced. Ashley Nurse to bowl now. There is a halt in play. The substitute brings in the helmet for Shai Hope.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Straying on the hips, Bairstow tucks it past short fine leg. Powell at long leg hares to his right but has no chance to stop it.
Shaping in on a fuller length to Jonny. He tucks it to mid-wicket and calls straightaway no for the run.
Short of a length on middle, tucked to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish delivery on middle, Roy drives it through wide mid on. Joseph hares after it to cut it off. Two runs taken.
Back of a length around off, Jonny places it to mid off for a quick single.
Short delivery on off, Roy pulls it uppishly and it falls just short of Gayle at mid-wicket.
Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off, Roy punches it to extra cover where the fielder makes a mess of it. Concedes a couple.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Close but he gets the desired result! Short delivery well outside off, Roy throws his bat at it. Gets it uppishly off the outer half towards Kyle Hope at gully. He leaps to his right but it goes over him and races to the fence.

Fractionally overpitched outside off, Roy punches it to long off. It is racing towards the fence. Wide long off in is in place. Powell from that region hares to his right, slides and makes a good stop. Saves a couple for his side.
Fullish delivery on the boots, clipped to long leg for a run.
Length delivery, angling in. Bairstow works it to wide mid on for a brisk single.
FOUR! Timing at its best! Fullish delivery outside off, Bairstow drives it on the up past mid off for another boundary. He is flowing at the moment.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on for a run.
Back of a length delivery, defended off the back foot.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.

Not Out! However, the Windies do not lose a review as it was umpire's call. On a length and angling in sharply from off. Roy looks to play it across but misses to be pinged on the pads. Cummins appeals confidently but it is turned down. Mohammed opts to take a review after having a look at his bowler. Time for the replays. It is going to clip the leg stump so the decision can't be overturned. Not a bad review!
West Indies opt to take a review against Roy. Looks close to the naked eye.
FOUR! Short and room on offer, Roy cuts it past the diving Mohammed at backward point. Once it went past him, there was no stopping that.
Fuller in length outside off, Roy times his stroke sweetly to extra cover.
Back of a length outside off, Jason cuts it hard towards Mohammed at point. He dives to his right to make a good stop.
Change of pace on off. Roy eases it to mid on.
Length delivery well outside off, Roy again goes at it with hard hands with a horizontal bat. Gets it through covers for a brace.
Fullish in length outside off, Roy goes for an expansive drive with a hard bottom hand but gets an inside edge towards mid on. His bat turned in his hands.
Fuller delivery on off, pushed to wide mid on for a run.
Straying on the pads, nudged through square leg for a couple.
On a length outside off, Roy hits it hard but finds Gayle who dives to his right to make a great stop. He had just came in that position.
Gayle comes in the short extra cover position.
FOUR! Well played! Short of a length outside off and width on offer. Roy has the opportunity to free his arms. Slaps it past the fielder at covers to find the fence again.
Good length outside off, pushed to covers.

FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Roy continues to pick up boundaries. Back of a length delivery outside off, Roy punches it off the back foot through covers. The timing is good and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Length delivery on middle, driven on the up to mid on.
Miguel Cummins comes into the attack.
On a length outside off, Roy pushes at it with minimal foot movement and gets a thick inside edge besides the pitch on the leg side. The batsmen sneak in a run.

Back of a length around off, Bairstow plays it with soft hands to covers and takes off. Powell attacks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The back up fielder dives but fails to stop it. Perhaps, Bairstow had run a long way and hence, the batsmen couldn't go for an overthrow.
Fullish on off, Bairstow pushes it back to the bowler.
Fraction short around off, stops a bit on the pitch. Bairstow pushes it to mid off from the back foot.
Fuller in length, angling in from outside off. Jonny eases it to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, punched sweetly to mid off.
On a length outside off, glided deftly to third man for a run and Bairstow will rotate strike.
Short of a length outside off, dabbed to backward point to rotate strike.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Roy is continuing his form from the last game. Short delivery on middle and leg, Roy swivels across and pulls it with authority through backward square leg to find the fence.
FOUR! Not off the meat of the bat but good enough! Fuller in length around off, Roy goes hard at it but gets it off the toe-end of the bat. Still, it beats mid on and runs away to the boundary.
Shorter in length on the hips, Roy pulls it through backward square leg for a brace. His bottom hand came off while playing that shot.
Back of  a length outside off, Roy mistimes his punch off the back foot to Samuels at covers. There is a bit of misfield but no harm done.
Angling into Jonny. He tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length delivery on off, Bairstow stands tall and knocks it to mid off.
On a length outside off, Roy goes for a drive but gets it off the outer half to third man. A run taken.
Good length ball outside off, a bit of extra bounce on that. Roy places it to cover-point.
Similar length delivery on off, Bairstow punches it on the up to mid off for a brisk single.
Fuller in length on off, Jonny puts his head down and defends it calmly.
FOUR! Shot! Short delivery on leg stump, sits up nicely for Roy. He gets into position and pulls it with aplomb through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary. 9 from the over.
Overpitched on middle, driven sweetly to mid on.
On the hips, tucked to deep backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Too full and straight, Bairstow times his clip to perfection and gets it away through mid-wicket for a boundary. The first of the innings.
Good length ball on off, pushed off the back foot down the track towards mid on.
That's nasty! Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Bairstow goes for the pull but gets hit on the arm. The ball deflects onto the grill of his helmet. That must have shaken him up.
Alzarri Joseph to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. He took a fifer in the last game. The Windies will hope that he replicates his form.
Length delivery on off, driven on the up to backward point. Good start from Taylor, only two from the first over.
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
On a length on off, swinging away a touch. Jason plays it with soft hands to covers.
In the channel outside off, a hint of away shape on that. Roy points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Bairstow is off the mark as well! Good length delivery on off, Bairstow taps it to covers and takes off. Good running between the wickets.
England are away! Starts off with a shortish delivery outside off, width on off. Roy slashes hard at it but gets it off the outer half to third man. A run taken.
We are back for the chase. Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow to open the innings for England. Jerome Taylor to start off with the first new ball for West Indies. Two slips in place. Here we go...
